payload.text: What is our SOP for spatial transcriptomics slide preparation?

matches.snippet:
Document: SOP-PREP-001 | Version 4 | Status: effective | Effective: 2025-04-07
Owner: lab operations lead | Approvers: qa-officer, lab-director
## 1. Purpose
This procedure defines library preparation for DNA and RNA specimens.
## 2. DNA Libraries
Germline panels and somatic calling use PCR-free WGS libraries.
matches.title: Library Preparation

matches.snippet:
Document: SOP-GERM-001 | Version 2 | Status: effective | Effective: 2025-02-10
Owner: bioinformatics lead | Approvers: qa-officer, lab-director
## 1. Purpose
This procedure governs germline panel analysis and reporting for inherited cancer predisposition.
## 2. Requirements
Germline panels require PCR-free WGS libraries prepared under SOP-PREP-001.
matches.title: Germline Panel Reporting

matches.snippet:
Review the sample and library selection before preparing any new draft.
Only a human-confirmed new draft can start another execution.
## 3. Sequencing Quality
Run-level base quality is released under SOP-SEQ-001 before readqc starts.
Libraries with a mapping rate below 95 percent are held for review.
Duplication above 15 percent is recorded on the QC review record but does not fail readqc.
matches.title: Read Quality and Low Purity Review

matches.snippet:
Degraded RNA below the integrity limit may be run with a documented deviation.
## 4. Indexing
Use unique dual indexes for every library to limit index hopping.
Record the index pair and lot number in the LIMS run sheet.
## 5. Revision History
| Version | Effective | Change |
| 3 | 2024-05-20 | Unique dual indexes required. |
| 4 | 2025-04-07 | Low-input PCR protocol limited to non-germline work. |
matches.title: Library Preparation

matches.title: Deviations and Corrective Actions

matches.snippet:
Readqc fails when a selected library's coverage is below the confirmed minimum coverage.
Normal and germline libraries require a mean coverage of at least 30x.
Tumor libraries intended for somatic calling require a mean coverage of at least 40x.
The 40x tumor minimum replaced the earlier 30x minimum on 2025-11-03 under change CHG-0021.
Confirm min_coverage 40 when preparing a readqc draft for tumor libraries.
Report…

payload.text:
I couldn’t find an effective SOP specifically for spatial transcriptomics slide preparation in the available knowledge base. The closest controlled document is SOP-PREP-001 v4, “Library Preparation,” which covers DNA and RNA library preparation—not spatial slide preparation. It states: “RNA libraries for fusion analysis use stranded poly-A selection.” [sop-prep-001-v4@4:L11-L14]

So I can’t provide slide-preparation steps from the available sources. You may need to check whether there’s a separate spatial assay SOP or ask the lab operations team.
